title: VLM-Guided Visual Place Recognition for Planet-Scale Geo-Localization

live_model.evidence: "we evaluate it using two recent state-of-the-art (SoTA) models: GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) ... and Gemini-1.5-Pro. Both models are prompted using the Least-to-Most (LTM) prompting strategy" (Sec. Method); Table 1/2 report accuracy at multiple spatial resolutions

prompt.note: "We use the LTM prompt from Mendes et al. [2024], which we omit here for brevity" -- the prompt is explicitly not reproduced, only cited to an external paper.

claim.metric: Street-level (1 km) localization accuracy (%), IM2GPS3k, GPT-4o + VPR pipeline
claim.location: Table 1/2 (geo-localization accuracy at 1/25/200/750/2500 km on IM2GPS3k [3,000 images], IM2GPS, and GWS15k)

data.source: IM2GPS3k and MP-16 (public); GWS15k is explicitly "not publicly available", reconstructed by the authors following Clark et al. [2023]'s instructions

notes: Otherwise a clean, dated role-B baseline (GPT-4o explicitly pinned), but the exact LTM prompt text used to query the VLM is deliberately omitted and only cited to Mendes et al. [2024]; one of the three benchmarks (GWS15k) is also not directly public.
